sections.heading: Adapt.io buyer question and thesis
sections.body:
B2B sales intelligence contact and company database with email/phone credits, Chrome extension, list building, and CRM export — Free through Basic published plans plus Custom packaging and a 7-day free trial. That orientation decides whether this implementation URL should exist separately from the Adapt.io hub.

Buyer question: choose Adapt.io only if SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans outweighs Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches — otherwise keep researching.

Verdict shape: yes for teams built around SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans; Buyers who prefer credit (not seat) packaging and Chrome-led email finding; Teams exporting contacts into CRM or SEP tools rather than sequencing in-app; no when Buyers who need a ranked SI shortlist peer with proven depth vs UpLead/Hunter/Apollo; Teams whose primary job is multichannel email sequencing; Enterprise buyers needing predictive ABM or phone-verified EMEA depth — contact data is the hinge, not brand familiarity.

Best for: SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans; Buyers who prefer credit (not seat) packaging and Chrome-led email finding; Teams exporting contacts into CRM or SEP tools rather than sequencing in-app (SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans).

Poor fit when: Buyers who need a ranked SI shortlist peer with proven depth vs UpLead/Hunter/Apollo; Teams whose primary job is multichannel email sequencing; Enterprise buyers needing predictive ABM or phone-verified EMEA depth. Avoid if Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches would block go-live.

sections.heading: Adapt.io limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Daily contact caps on Free/Starter/Basic constrain volume because it forces process changes or add-ons around Adapt.io when prospecting is the job.

Pricing interpretation: stay on Free until contact data is mandatory; plan jumps to Starter only after that hinge is proven.

Plan trade-off: you gain contact data at the expense of Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Free · free · contact data | Starter | Basic.

Alternative context: unlike UpLead, Adapt.io is preferable when SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans because prospecting plus contact data match; prefer UpLead when Buyers who need a ranked SI shortlist peer with proven depth vs UpLead/Hunter/Apollo because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Adapt.io
sections.body:
Scenario: for prospecting teams, recommend Adapt.io when SMB/mid-market teams wanting a regional contact DB peer with published credit plans; recommend an alternative path when Buyers who need a ranked SI shortlist peer with proven depth vs UpLead/Hunter/Apollo because Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches dominates.

Implementation effort: setup takes a named admin for prospecting plus a freeze window if Salesforce are in the cutover path.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Outreach.

Final call: proceed with Adapt.io when prospecting plus contact data outweigh Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; walk when Buyers who need a ranked SI shortlist peer with proven depth vs UpLead/Hunter/Apollo because workarounds will eat the Starter spend.
